rationale: Coprococcus comes is a butyrate fermenter. At turn 4, lactate and glucose remain abundant. I continue mixed-acid fermentation of these preferred substrates, with nitrogen from arginine, cysteine, and ammonium. Growth is limited by available nitrogen (~0.45 /h). Carbon balance is maintained: 100 mmol C in supports 13.5 mmol C biomass plus ~50 mmol C in acetate, butyrate, and CO₂, with remainder in minor products.
